title: ブラシと泥落とし刃付きの靴清掃台
description: 公園・作業区画の入口で長靴の泥落としを表現する据置式ステーション。足裏用と左右側面用の交換ブラシブロック、独立した毛束、前面の泥落とし刃、透かし底受け、固定脚と握りレールを備えます。靴・泥は含みません。清掃性能・衛生性能・転倒防止などの安全性は検証していません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.729 × 1.069 × 0.688 m、24,660三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A fixed boot-cleaning prop for park or worksite entrances, with replaceable sole and twin side brush blocks, separate bristle tufts, a front scraper blade, open slatted debris tray, anchor feet and steadying grip rail. No boots or dirt included. Cleaning efficacy, hygiene performance and safety including fall prevention have not been validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.729 × 1.069 × 0.688 m; 24,660 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
